name: gas-two-costs
description: The two experiments of the FALL script (文案 03a-05c). One pure MPC (CEM, defaults) and three costs: C1 = the land objective without its gas term (w_gas 0: touchdown speed / tilt / rate, attitude in the air and on the ground, crash, wheel loads; gas only bounded by the tank), C2 = the land objective as shipped (+ 0.3 per kg), C3 = + 1 per kg. Each from the default all-closed cold start (zero) and from a hover cold start (heave 0.33 ≈ the weight at full tank): the receding horizon keeps the basin of its first plan, so a single start cannot show which strategy a cost prefers. Every flight is scored afterwards by every cost on its realized trajectory (tools/flight/gas/twocost.mjs); `select` keeps per (preset, seed) the cheaper of the two starts under each cost (two-start MPC). C1s: C1 + w_sink 0.02 (descent faster than 3 m/s priced all the way down), a sensitivity score only.
